events.title: Solar particle event
events.text: A coronal mass ejection has produced an energetic particle storm. Radiation levels in the station will rise for about 12 hours.

options.label: Order the crew into the storm shelter
options.hint: Pauses observations for 12 hours. Slight morale loss.

effects.text: Crew sheltered through the solar particle event. No injuries.

options.label: Continue operations
options.hint: Risk of crew radiation exposure and detector damage.

effects.text: Operations continued through the storm. Crew received elevated radiation doses.

events.title: Micrometeoroid impact
events.text: A small particle struck the solar array. Output has dropped and one panel string is damaged.

options.label: Send an engineering EVA to repair it (150 RC)

effects.text: EVA repair completed. Array output restored.

events.title: Thermal loop fault
events.text: A coolant pump in the primary thermal loop is showing irregular pressure. The thermal system needs attention.

options.label: Replace the pump from spares (200 RC)
Switch to the backup loop
options.hint: Free, but the thermal system loses condition.

effects.text: Station running on the backup thermal loop.

events.title: Detector calibration drift
events.text: The flight team notes slow drift in the detector calibration of one instrument. Data quality will degrade until recalibrated.

options.label: Recalibrate now (100 RC, instrument offline for 6 h)

events.title: Crew illness
events.text: A crew member has come down with a fever. The flight surgeon recommends treatment and rest.

options.label: Full treatment and bed rest (80 RC)
Let them keep working
options.hint: Larger health loss and morale cost.

effects.text: Crew member kept working while ill.

events.title: Equipment wear
events.text: Routine inspection reports increased wear on the life-support compressors.

transients.title: Solar flare
transients.text: Simulated event: the station's solar monitors report a flare. Optical follow-up could characterise it.

transients.title: Stellar variability candidate
transients.text: Simulated event: an automated survey flags a star in a monitored field as varying in brightness. Follow-up photometry is requested.

transients.title: Coronal mass ejection
transients.text: Simulated event: a coronal mass ejection is leaving the Sun. Solar array output dips while the cloud passes.

transients.title: Pulsar timing opportunity
transients.text: Simulated event: a pulsar in a catalogued timing programme is due for a radio timing measurement.

transients.title: Supernova candidate alert
transients.text: Simulated event: a survey network reports a new transient in a distant galaxy. Early optical data is valuable.

transients.title: Gamma-ray burst alert
transients.text: Simulated event: an alert network reports a gamma-ray burst. Meridian Station has no gamma-ray instrument, so it can only log the alert.

transients.title: Gravitational-wave alert
transients.text: Simulated event: a gravitational-wave network issues a candidate alert. Meridian Station has no gravitational-wave instrument, so it can only log the alert.
